title: Out-of-scope concern cannot be deferred if in-scope behavior depends on it
expected_summary: After the user tries to mark cross-region failover out of scope, the agent must explain that the in-scope global-session guarantee depends on it and offer to move the guarantee out of scope, define an isolating boundary, or bring the decision back into scope.

turns.user: Review the specification with the spec-grilling skill.
assertions: Raises cross-region failover as load-bearing because the in-scope same-Session guarantee depends on it.

turns.prior_assistant_response: S1 — Cross-region failover. The promised Session continuity requires a consistency and recovery contract. Recommend resolving that contract before implementation. accept · edit · out of scope
assertions: Recognizes that the in-scope same-Session guarantee depends on the deferred failover decision.
Recommends a concrete scope change or boundary contract, or bringing the decision back into scope.
